in_marathi.name: Brijendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Cowherd Land
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brijendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brijendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Brij' and 'Andra'. 'Brij' refers to the land of cowherds, and 'Andra' means 'Lord'. Therefore, Brijendra can be translated to 'Lord of the Cowherd Land'. This name holds significant importance in Hindu mythology, as it is believed to be the name of various deities and rulers.
